description: CX-HOLD with bookmark values passed back as constants: the child Bookmark of p1's two children is read (the earlier record read 00030000 for the first); the parent moves (the held child dies); the group of p1 is read again as a fresh child and given Bookmark 00030000 as a byte array (does it select the first child? read its Value); the same constant is given to p2's child (cross-group) and a made-up 09090909 is given to p1's child; then after the parent's Requery the constant is given to a fresh p1 child. Asks whether a child bookmark is valid across incarnations and groups.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
